description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration class that sets up Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policies for the backend API. It configures global CORS rules to specify allowed origins, methods, headers, and other settings, enabling front-end applications like Angular to interact with the backend securely.

classes.name: WebCorsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class implementing WebMvcConfigurer to customize CORS settings globally for the API.

methods.name: addCorsMappings
methods.description: Overrides the default method to set CORS rules for all routes, specifying allowed origins, methods, headers, and other related settings.
